propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) in dispatch_one.create_one triggers delete_issue, destroying a successfully-created Jira issue to recover from a labelling failure

The write-ahead binding (record_pending_key) executes before identity writes but is never unbound on rollback, leaving a keyed-pending entry pointing to a now-deleted key that strands the local ticket permanently

The Jira error 'Field cannot be set. It is not on the appropriate screen' is misleading: it occurs when the field is genuinely missing from the screen, when jira.permission.createclone.denied is set, or when the field value is malformed
The recovery path (recover_pending keyed branch) already exists to retro-attach identity markers without search and is designed to handle exactly the state left by a failed identity write
Deletion is redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery and worse because it destroys created work while a keyed-pending binding is repairable
The requirement that labels must be on the project's Create and Edit screens should be explicitly declared as a prerequisite rather than solved through createmeta pre-flight discovery
